LESSON: MYSELF ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.1: Myself ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Myself ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is your name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group
2. identify their sex for themselves according to sex self-awareness • Learners are guided on picture
3. identify body parts reading categorizing boys and (head, hands and legs) girls

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group
   In simple words: practise until you can tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. identify their sex for themselves according to sex self-awareness • Learners are guided on picture
   In simple words: practise until you can identify their sex for themselves according to sex self-awareness • Learners are guided on picture. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. identify body parts reading categorizing boys and (head, hands and legs) girls
   In simple words: practise until you can identify body parts reading categorizing boys and (head, hands and legs) girls. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Myself ENVIRONMENT using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Myself ENVIRONMENT in the examples.
2. Explain Myself ENVIRONMENT to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Myself ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Myself ENVIRONMENT using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Myself ENVIRONMENT important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

5. Self-esteem identify body parts (head hands and legs)

SECTION: REMEMBER
